nodes.meaning: Business meaning for evaluating one bounded D65 construction attempt without performing its work or granting authority.
An immutable no-effect evaluator contract binding exact active D65 and D67 source sections, the ordered D65 stage vocabulary, and two-lane planning policies.
The attempt-side exact ref and raw-byte digest plus the subject, Project, stage set, repository-locality, reversibility, and effect ceiling asserted for one bounded attempt.
A closed immutable record resolved through the attempt ref and digest that binds construction, attempt, program, Project, subject, permitted stages, locality, reversibility, and zero-effect ceiling.
One bounded two-lane plan and observation of ordered D65 product-construction stages, operational-support tasks, owner gates, blockers, and an optional human-test packet reference.
A two-lane plan that keeps product construction runnable while separately exposing operational support, exact frontier dependencies, applicable boundaries, and deferred operational residue.
A product-construction lane observation containing the applicability, state, exact repository artifact identity, and exact owner-gate evidence posture for one ordered D65 stage.
An operational-support lane observation with state, owner, exact applicable D65 stage or null, and a typed blocking basis. Unrelated or future operational work is deferred as visible residue.
Pending or blocked operational-support work that is not an exact prerequisite or applicable safety or authority boundary at the current product-construction frontier.
A closed immutable no-effect record binding one required stage decision to the exact attempt, Project, subject, authorization, and scope.
A dependent stage is blocked or not_evaluable when an earlier applicable predecessor is not validated.

The canonical non-self-referential basis over construction and attempt identity, exact program, authorization envelope, stages, blockers, and routine-confirmation posture, excluding only the packet reference.

One closed frozen immutable human-test input binding construction and attempt identities, Project, subject, exact program and authorization, stage set, attempt basis, decision, owner, procedure, residue, rollback, challenge route, and prior decisions without a mutable outcome.
One immutable passed-or-failed result that references the exact frozen packet ref and digest exercised by the human.
Exactly CONTINUE, STOP, READY_FOR_HUMAN_TEST, or REQUEST_TERMINAL_CONFIRMATION.
A causal request to resolve invalid evidence, stale bytes, scope, test failure, or another real blocker; it is not routine confirmation.
A causal request for one missing owner gate; it is not routine confirmation or inferred authority.
A later applicable stage cannot validate or advance while any earlier applicable predecessor is not validated.
An eligible authorized repository-local reversible next stage returns CONTINUE with routine_confirmation_required false.
Every plan identifies D65 stages as product-construction work and operational tasks as operational-support work without collapsing either lane into the other.

Pending operational support cannot stop a dependency-ready product-construction frontier unless it is an exact prerequisite for that frontier or an applicable safety, privacy, authority, destructive-action, credential, or external-effect boundary.
Unrelated or future operational support remains visible as deferred residue while eligible product construction continues.
A terminal confirmation request requires all applicable stages validated and an exact frozen packet with a passing human test.
A terminal request cannot cure an earlier skipped predecessor, missing gate, stale stage, or changed packet.
Every evaluation is advisory candidate evidence with authority_effect none and effect_authorized false.

claim_limit: Capability-local candidate meaning only; no adopted Constitution or Product Capability, admitted profile or ontology, accepted implementation, conformance, activation, routing, publication, release, or deployment.
